behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Old versions survive set/delete while prefix results sort before limiting.
Nested input and output mutations cannot change stored versions.
docDelivery: Persistent updates, duplicate initialization, missing deletion and internal structure freedom.
ASCII prefix/limit semantics and detached value ownership.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Nonempty ASCII keys, ASCII prefix including empty, limit omitted or integer 0..1000; values ordinary acyclic JSON without getters/custom methods/undefined/symbols/nonfinite numbers/-0. Initial entries dense {key,value} array, duplicate keys last value wins.
independence: Implement persistent prefix dictionary updates, deletion and sorted prefix queries with snapshot isolation.
